source: 647 “Inexplicable Action”
target: 647 “Actio Inexplicabilis”

source: In the face of the flaming spear, Twanaku’s eyes, now crimson from the Devil Transformation, reflected dancing and burning crimson flames.
target: In conspectu hastae flammeae, oculi Twanaku, nunc ex transmutatione diabolica rubicundi, effulgebant flammae saltantes et ardentes rubicundae.

source: He remained unfazed.
target: Non perturbatus remansit.

source: Instead, he conjured an aberration–a broadsword made of crimson magma and pale-blue flames.
target: Potius, evocavit aberrationem – ensis lati factus ex magma rubicundo et flammis caeruleis pallidis.

source: Swiftly turning, Twanaku exposed his back to the flaming spear.
target: Celeriter convertens, Twanaku terga ad hastam flammeam exposuit.

source: With the magma broadsword in hand, he slashed at the foe who had seemingly teleported behind him, launching an attack.
target: Manu tenens ensis magmaticus, hosti qui ut videbatur post eum teleportatus, secans impetum iniit.

source: The broadsword, adorned with crimson magma and pale-blue flames, sliced through the air but missed Lumian.
target: Ensis, ornatus magmatis rubicundi et flammarum caerulearum pallidorum, per aerem secabat sed Lumian non contigit.

source: It left only an exaggerated mark on the wall behind, a testament to its destructive force.
target: Reliquit solam notam exaggeratam in pariete posteriore, testimonium vim destructoriam exhibens.

source: Had it not been for the Bottle of Fiction’s protection, the bathroom wall would have been split in half.
target: Nisi ob tutelam Ampullae Fictionis, paries balnei in duas partes diviseretur.

source: Even so, the bottle visibly trembled, bearing some damage.
target: Attamen, ampulla palam trepidabat, aliqua damna ferens.

source: The nearly white flaming spear also struck Twanaku’s back, piercing a little before being halted by the elastic dark skin and sturdy flesh.
target: Hasta flammea, paene alba, etiam terga Twanaku percussit, paullo penetrans antequam elasticam, obscuram cutem et robustam carnem obsisteret.

source: It failed to penetrate the Devil’s body, leaving only blackened traces from the resulting inferno.
target: Non penetravit corpus Diaboli, relinquens solum vestigia nigra ex igne consequenti.

source: Devils, armored in thick and tough natural protection, were resistant to flames, poison, and curses to a certain extent.
target: Diaboli, armati crassa et dura tutela naturali, ignibus, veneno, et maledictis ad aliquod modum resistentes erant.

source: Twanaku, in his Zombie state, possessed a steel-like body that could withstand bullets and cannonballs.
target: Twanaku, in statu zombie, possidebat corpus quasi chalybeum quod bullis et globis tormentariis opponi poterat.

source: Lumian’s flaming spear and fireball attacks, as well as the Fire Ravens’ onslaught, posed little threat.
target: Hasta flammea Lumiani et impetus sphaerarum ignium, necnon impetus Corvorum Igneorum, parum minabantur.

source: Standing still, Twanaku could endure repeated attacks without suffering severe injuries.
target: Stans quietus, Twanaku impetus repetitos sine gravioribus laesionibus sustinere valebat.

source: Additionally, his ability to transform into a Wraith allowed him to evade explosions effortlessly.
target: Praeterea, facultas sua in umbram transformandi ei permisit explosionibus facile evadere.

source: “Hisoka” Twanaku believed that, without the support of the Tarot Club, the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, and powerful demigods, he could have tortured Lumian to death.
target: “Hisoka” Twanaku credidit se, sine auxilio Taroti Club, Societatis Inquisitionis Simiarum Crispipedarum, et potentium semideorum, posse Lumian ad mortem tormentare.

source: Even with teleportation, spells rendering him temporarily unconscious, and mystical items, most of Lumian’s attacks were ineffective against Wraiths and Desire Apostle Beyonders.
target: Etiamsi teleportatione, incantationibus eum ad tempus inconscum reddentibus, et rebus mysticis, pleraeque impetus Lumiani adversus umbras et Apostolos Desiderii Beyonders ineficaces erant.

source: The Psychic Shock and Desire Detonation further restrained him, leaving him vulnerable to the assaults of Wraiths and undead creatures.
target: Impactus psychicus et detonatio Desiderii eum ulterius cohibuerunt, relinquens eum vulnerabilem ad impetus umbrarum et creaturarum mortuorum.

source: Having missed his strike, Twanaku noticed Lumian’s figure reappear in midair.
target: Post ictum suum fallitum, Twanaku animadvertit figuram Lumiani in medio aeri iterum apparere.

source: As anticipated, Lumian had chosen to teleport behind and launch an attack.
target: Ut exspectatum erat, Lumian elegit se teleportare post et impetum iniisse.

source: However, there was a notable change compared to previous encounters.
target: Attamen, notabilis mutatio comparata cum prioribus congressionibus apparuit.

source: Hovering near the ceiling and the vent, Lumian opened his mouth and emitted a harrumph.
target: Iuxta laquearia et ventilum, Lumian os aperuit et exclamavit “harrumph”.

source: The moment a pale-yellow light shot out, Hisoka Twanaku’s figure faded and vanished.
target: Instante quo lumen pallideflavum emiit, figura “Hisoka” Twanaku evanuit.

source: In Lumian’s pupils, a devilish figure materialized–dark skin, long goat horns, bat wings on its back, and no longer wielding the Sword of Lava.
target: In pupillis Lumiani, figura diabolica apparuit – cutis obscura, cornua caprina longa, alae vespertilionis in dorso, nec iam Gladio Lavae utebatur.

source: Swiftly, Twanaku transformed into a Wraith, leaping into Lumian’s eyes, deftly dodging the Spell of Harrumph’s attack.
target: Celeriter, Twanaku in umbram se transformavit, in oculos Lumiani saliens, callide incantationem “harrumph” ictum evitans.

source: Devil Transformation didn’t impede his Wraith abilities!
target: Transformatio Diabolica non impedit virtutes umbrarum eius!

source: Lumian’s face paled, a dark-green hue tinting his features.
target: Facies Lumiani palluit, et vultus eius viridi obscuro tinctus est.

source: His hands involuntarily rose, reaching for his neck, and his body plummeted to the ground.
target: Manus eius inviti surrexerunt, ad collum suum tendentes, et corpus eius in terram deiectum est.

source: Prepared for such a situation, Lumian didn’t resist.
target: Praeparatus ad talem condicionem, Lumian non resistit.

source: While he could still struggle, he didn’t halt his hands or resist the Wraith’s control.
target: Quamquam adhuc pugnare poterat, manus eius non sistit neque repugnabat imperio umbrarum.

source: Instead, he sank his consciousness into his right hand.
target: Potius, conscientiam suam in manum dexteram immergit.

source: The frenzied, bloody aura of superiority dissipated slightly, causing Twanaku to instinctively tremble.
target: Aura furibunda et sanguinea superioritatis paulo evanuit, causa Twanaku instinctive tremere faciens.

source: He subconsciously detached from Lumian’s body and leaped onto the sink.
target: Subconscii disiunxit a corpore Lumiani et in lavacrum saliit.

source: Lumian activated the black mark on his right shoulder, vanishing before crashing to the ground.
target: Lumian signum nigrum in umero dextro activavit, evanescens antequam in terram corruperit.

source: This time, he appeared behind the motionless silver-white full-body armor.
target: Hoc tempore, apparuit post loricam totius corporis argenteo-albam immobilis.

source: Behind!
target: Retro!

source: The Pride Armor spun around abruptly, raising the broadsword of light and slashing at Lumian in the not-too-small bathroom.
target: Loricata Superbia subito circumversum est, ensim lucis elevans et in Lumian, in balneo non parvi, secans.

source: Lumian employed Spirit World Traversal once more, vanishing from the silver armor’s path.
target: Lumian iterum Transitus Mundi Spirituum adhibuit, evanens ex via loricae argenteae.

source: Within the mirror, “Hisoka” Twanaku was somewhat bewildered.
target: In speculo, “Hisoka” Twanaku paulo perplectus erat.

source: Why did Lumian Lee provoke his Sealed Artifact and engage in combat with it?
target: Cur Lumian Lee suum Artefactum Sigillatum provocavit et cum eo pugnavit?

source: Am I not his enemy target?
target: Nonne ego non sum scopus hostilis eius?

source: The negative effects of a Sealed Artifact?
target: Effectus adversos artefacti sigillati?

source: Though he didn’t understand what was going on, Twanaku sensed danger instinctively.
target: Quamquam quid ibi ageretur non intellexit, Twanaku per instinctum periculum sensit.

source: His Danger Premonition, along with a possible insight from Emperor Roselle–“If something shows signs of abnormality, there must be an abnormal factor hidden. Such factors often signify danger.”
target: Praemonitio Periculi eius, una cum fortasse intuitu ab Imperatore Roselle – “Si quid ostendit indicia abnormalitatis, necesse est aliquem factor anormalem latere; tales factores saepe periculum significant.”

source: Without hesitation, Twanaku left the sink and leaped to the bathroom door in his colossal Devil form.
target: Sine mora, Twanaku lavacrum reliquit et ad ostium balnei in forma colossali Diaboli saliit.

source: Conjuring a dozen or so light-blue Sulfur Fireballs, he directed them at the wooden door in unison.
target: Conjurans duodecim aut aliquot sphaeras ignis sulphuris caeruleo pallido, eas in ostium ligneum simul destinavit.

source: Twanaku, who had shaken the Bottle of Fiction with his sword, knew that the current seal could be broken by brute force.
target: Twanaku, qui Ampullam Fictionis gladio suo concussit, scivit sigillum praesens vi brute dissolvi posse.

source: There was no need to find the true exit or kill the enemy who had constructed the seal.
target: Nulla necessitas erat veram exitum quaerere aut hostem, qui sigillum aedificaverat, occidere.

source: For this reason, he chose to forgo teaming up with the full-body armor to assail Lumian.
target: Propter hoc, constituit a coniunctione cum lorica totius corporis abstinere, ut Lumian oppugnaretur.

source: He reckoned that any further delay, even if Lumian Lee were to fall on the spot, would lead to him being surrounded, facing a lethal blow with no chance of escaping alive.
target: Putabat quod ulterius mora, etiam si Lumian Lee in loco caderet, eum circumferri atque ictui letali, sine ulla spe salutis, affici posset.

source: In such a scenario, killing Lumian Lee would render the effort meaningless!
target: In tali condicione, interficere Lumian Lee totum conatum inanem redderet!

source: Certainly, Twanaku wasn’t about to let Lumian off easily.
target: Certe, Twanaku Lumian facile dimittere noluit.

source: Following the Sulfur Fireball assault, he clenched his fists and spoke a word in Devil language filled with depravity and filth.
target: Post impetus sphaerarum ignis sulphuris, manus suas contraxit et verbum in lingua Diaboli, sordibus ac depravatione plenum, edixit.

source: “Slow!”
target: “Lente!”

source: This was a manifestation of the Language of Foulness, capable of stiffening and even halting the movements of targets within a seven- to eight-meter radius for approximately two seconds.
target: Hoc erat manifestatio Linguae Foetidae, quae motus scoporum intra radium septem ad octo metrorum per circiter duas secundas rigere et sistendere valebat.

source: Considering the bathroom’s size, this radius covered the entire area.
target: Propter magnitudinem balnei, hic radius totam aream tegebat.

source: Lumian’s form reappeared.
target: Figura Lumiani iterum apparuit.

source: Once more, he teleported behind the Pride Armor, conjuring a crimson fireball almost white in his hand.
target: Iterum, se teleportavit post Loricam Superbiam, et in manu globum ignis rubicundus, fere album, conjuravit.

source: Influenced by the Language of Foulness, both Lumian and the Pride Armor moved sluggishly.
target: Sub influxu Linguae Foetidae, et Lumian et Lorica Superbia lente movebantur.

source: One “slowly” launched a fireball, while the other struggled to turn around, as if its joints had rusted.
target: Unus lente globum ignis iacit, dum alter conabatur se vertire, quasi iuncturae eius russae essent.

source: Rumble!
target: Tumultus!

source: The Sulfur Fireballs erupted against the bathroom door.
target: Sphaerae ignis sulphuris contra ostium balnei erupere coeperunt.

source: A translucent, illusory membrane materialized on the bathroom’s side.
target: Membrana translucida et illusoria in latere balnei apparuit.

source: Like glass, it shattered inch by inch, leaving crisscrossing marks that teetered on the brink of collapse.
target: Sicut vitrum, ea pollice gradatim confracta sunt, relinquentes vestigia cruciata quae ad ruinae limen tendebant.

source: The wooden door appeared charred and pieced together, reminiscent of a child’s broken toy hastily glued back together.
target: Ostium ligneum apparuit ustulatum et reparatum, quod instar ludi fracti pueri festinanter adligati memorabat.

source: Observing this, “Hisoka” Twanaku grasped that another strike could completely shatter the seal.
target: Hoc observans, “Hisoka” Twanaku intellexit alium ictum sigillum omnino confracturum esse.

source: This time, he gathered seven to eight light-blue Sulfur Fireballs.
target: Hoc tempore, congregavit septem ad octo sphaeras ignis sulphuris caeruleo pallido.

source: On the opposite end, Lumian’s fireball finally collided with the Pride Armor’s back, assisted by the explosive waves.
target: In extremo opposito, sphaera ignis Lumiani tandem in tergum Loricae Superbiae percussit, adiuta fluctibus explosivis.

source: Amidst the rumbling and clanging, the silver armor stiffened.
target: Inter fremitu et clangore, lorica argentea rigescit.

source: Lumian activated the black mark on his right shoulder once more and teleported away from his current location.
target: Lumian signum nigrum in umero dextro iterum activavit et se ab currenti loco teleportavit.

source: Almost simultaneously, the Pride Armor overcame the effects of Slow with abnormal swiftness, swiftly turning around.
target: Fere simul, Lorica Superbia effectus “Lente” celeritate insolitè superavit, circumversa celeriter.

source: However, it still couldn’t lock onto its target.
target: Attamen, nihilominus, in scopus suos incidere non poterat.

source: Twanaku felt a surge of amusement bubbling within him but maintained an unusual vigilance.
target: Twanaku sensit impulsum iocis intus effluere, sed vigilentiam insolitam retinuit.

source: His only wish was that the relentless bombardment would shatter the seal completely, granting him an avenue for escape.
target: Unum optabat, ut indefessa bombardatio sigillum penitus confrangeret, viam sibi evadendi praebens.

source: In the next moment, the Sulfur Fireballs collided with the wooden door at the bathroom entrance.
target: In proximo momento, sphaerae ignis sulphuris contra ostium ligneum introitus balnei convenerunt.

source: Twanaku witnessed the silver-white full-body armor squat down, driving the broadsword of light into the ground.
target: Twanaku vidit loricam totius corporis argenteo-albam se procumbentem, ensim lucis in terram ferientem.

source: Wh— Twanaku’s pupils dilated as he instinctively readied himself to transform into a Wraith.
target: Heu— pupillae Twanaku dilatatae sunt, atque se instinctive ad umbram transformandam praeparabat.

source: Yet, he held back, exercising restraint.
target: Attamen, se continuit, moderationem exercens.

source: Aware of the potential consequences within the Warrior pathway, he understood the risk of subjecting himself to even greater harm.
target: Conscius consequentiarum in via Bellatoris, intellexit periculum se ipsum etiam gravioribus laesionibus subire.

source: Rumble!
target: Tumultus!

source: Simultaneously with the explosion of the Sulfur Fireballs, the Sword of Dawn, embedded in the crevice in the stone tiles by the Pride Armor, disintegrated into fragments of light.
target: Simul cum explosione sphaerarum ignis sulphuris, Gladius Aurorae, in fovea in laminis lapideis iuxta Loricam Superbiae insitus, in fragmenta lucis disiunctus est.

source: Densely packed, they formed a flickering, violent, and sharp hurricane that swept in all directions, filled with the intent to annihilate everything.
target: Densissime dispositi, conformaverunt turbam micantem, violentam, et acutam, quae in omnes partes dispersa est, proposito omnia delere.

source: Hurricane of Light!
target: Turbo Lucis!

source: Since it couldn’t lock onto the backstabber, it opted for a wide-ranging assault!
target: Cum enim in perfidum hostem incidere non poterat, oppetationem latiorem optavit!

source: The sharp and terrifying storm of light enveloped Twanaku and Kolobo on the ground.
target: Tempestas acuta et terribilis lucis, Twanaku et Kolobo in terra involvit.

source: Lumian materialized in front of the latter, crouched down, shielding vital points.
target: Lumian coram illo apparuit, genu flectens, puncta vitalia tuens.

source: He faced the formidable hurricane head-on.
target: Facie in facie, turbam formidabilem contendit.

source: The washroom bore the brunt of the assault.
target: Balneum impetus maximos tulit.

source: The urinal was wrecked, and the cubicles silently collapsed, shedding a layer of bricks.
target: Urinalis dirutus est, et cubicula silentio corruperunt, dimittens stratum laterum.

source: As a depraved creature, Twanaku had nowhere to hide.
target: Ut creatura depravata, Twanaku nusquam se abscondere poterat.

source: All he could do was endure the damage, his eyes flickering with a sharp light.
target: Tantum pati damna poterat, oculis eius luce acuta micantibus.

source: In the radiant blades’ storm, Lumian’s figure cracked inch by inch, shattering into numerous mirror fragments.
target: In tempestate laminarum radiantium, figura Lumiani pollice gradatim confracta est, in fragmenta specularia numerosa dissoluta.

source: Mirror Substitution!
target: Substitutio Speculi!

source: With his obstruction, Kolobo avoided fatal injuries but couldn’t escape multiple bleeding wounds.
target: Ob impedimentum eius, Kolobo laesiones mortiferas vitavit, sed ex plurimis vulneribus sanguinolentis evadere non potuit.

source: In Camus’s office, within the beige four-story building housing the patrol team.
target: In officio Camus, intra aedificium quattuor tabulatum colore beige, quod turmam vigilantium continebat.

source: Crouched behind a table, Camus’s face turned pale, tinged with a dark-green hue.
target: Sub mensa sedens, facies Camus palluit, et tincta colore viridi obscuro.

source: It was as if a grayish-white clown laughed exaggeratedly in his eyes.
target: Sicut quasi clown cineraceus in oculis eius nimis exaggeratus ridebat.

source: Camus strained to ignite bolts of lightning in his eyes, piercing Sow’s mind.
target: Camus studuit in oculis suis fulminum sagittas incendere, mentem Sow pertingens.

source: His betraying teammate grimaced in pain, causing his broadsword to lose strength and direction, crashing into the desk and failing to hit Camus.
target: Socius eius proditor, dolore contorsus, faciebat ut ensis eius vigorem et directionem amisisset, in mensam corruit et Camum non percussit.

source: In that critical moment, Camus drew a silver revolver from his right hand, aiming it not at Sow but at himself.
target: In illo momento critico, Camus revolver argenteum e manu dextro extraxit, non ad Sow, sed ad se ipsum destinans.

source: Across the street, in a room facing Camus’s office,
target: Trans viam, in conclavi coram officio Camus,

source: Jenna, holding a telescope, huddled by the curtain, closely monitored Camus’s condition.
target: Jenna, telescopum tenens, se ad velum congregavit, et conditionem Camus diligenter observavit.

source: Seeing the other party under attack and struggling, she swiftly grabbed the loudspeaker she had prepared and brought it to her mouth.
target: Videns adversarium sub impetu esse et luctari, celeriter eductorem sonorum, quem paraverat, arripuit et ad os suum attulit.

source: “Camus has been attacked!
target: “Camus oppugnatum est!

source: “Camus has been attacked by the Rose School of Thought!
target: “Camus a Schola Rosae Cogitationis oppugnatum est!

source: “Camus is being attacked in his office!”
target: “Camus in officio suo oppugnatur!”

source: The loudspeaker’s sound reverberated through every room of the patrol team.
target: Sonus eductoris sonorum per omnes cellas turmae vigilantium resonavit.
